legitimateExplanations.title: An unexpected driver and vehicle arrive for a booked load.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A legitimate last-minute reallocation within the operator, or an approved subcontractor, that was not communicated to the dock.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Verify with the operator by calling the number held on the carrier master record, never the number offered by the driver, and confirm the substitution before releasing cargo.

legitimateExplanations.title: Driver presents printed or photographed paperwork.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Normal practice for many small operators, particularly on subcontracted or spot work.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Do not treat document format as the test. Test identity: does the vehicle belong to the contracted operator and does the operator confirm this driver for this load.

legitimateExplanations.title: A second driver or vehicle appears for the same movement after the first presentation.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A documented relay, recovery, shift change or approved substitution whose dispatch update did not reach the gate in time.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Confirm the handover through the pre-existing carrier contact and retain the original and replacement identity records with the reason and time of the change.

countermeasures.text: Check the gate log against open bookings in real time so that a second presentation for the same reference is caught while the vehicle is still on site.
Treat the event as a theft from the moment of the mismatch, not from the expiry of the delivery window, since the first hours determine whether recovery is possible.
